copy_order_argument: The benchmark defines one shared geometry, legal transformations and cutting parameters per part family, with a quantity of identical copies. Permuting the complete mode/anchor assignments among the mandatory short-sheet copies of one family preserves every source polygon, cutout, stock condition and pair gap; the selected short identities and first-sheet complement remain the same. Sort each family by normalized x anchor (cog center x for cogs), with any tie order. Nearest-grid rounding is monotone, so ten adjacent nondecreasing x inequalities do not exclude a source-feasible allocation. No cross-family ordering is imposed.
